title: SkillManifest
description: Parsed and validated SKILL.md YAML frontmatter, per the Agent Skills specification (agentskills.io/specification). Stored as skill_versions.manifest_json.

name.description: Lowercase alphanumerics and single hyphens; no leading/trailing/consecutive hyphens. Must equal the skill directory name. Must not contain reserved words 'anthropic'/'claude' on Anthropic surfaces.

description.description: What the skill does AND when to use it. Level-1 (always-loaded) content.

license.description: License name or reference to a bundled license file.

compatibility.description: Environment requirements (intended product, packages, network access).

metadata.description: Arbitrary string->string map. Convention: metadata.version holds the author's version string (there is no first-class version field in the spec).

allowedTools.description: Space-separated pre-approved tool list (experimental). Raw string as authored, e.g. 'Bash(git:*) Read'.
